title: Sunday Reset Beats Monday Motivation
hook: You don't need Monday motivation. You need a Sunday evening reset.
caption: Monday chaos usually starts on Sunday. My reset: dump every loose note into an AI chat, let it sort the pile into this week, later and delete, and wipe the desk while it works. Monday I open the list and go. What's the first thing you'd hand off?
voiceoverScript: You don't need Monday motivation. You need a Sunday evening reset. First, I close every tab and paste my scattered notes into an AI chat. I ask it to sort them into this week, later, and delete. Then I clear my desk while it drafts my top three priorities. Monday morning, I just open the list and start.
